claim_text: Low fruit and vegetable intake can make vitamin C dietary adequacy worth reviewing, but it does not by itself diagnose deficiency or establish a need for high-dose supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People reporting low fruit and vegetable intake.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin C fact sheet describes dietary sources and reference values.
limitations: No dose from this claim; assess full diet and current products.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
